sections.name: Official milXdy add-ons
sections.description: The current reviewed package boundaries. Pets Maker is the first catalog-installed app; BOORU and Meme Maker remain Composer Kit capabilities, not separate add-ons.

packages.name: Pets Maker
packages.summary: Prepare a validated local Remilia Maker avatar bundle for the Custom Pet pipeline.

notes: Reviewed optional package moved from the local pilot into the pinned maintainer catalog source tree.
Installation leaves the enablement setting false; the user must explicitly enable Pets Maker in Apps & Features.
The 0.1.1 review covers the explicit public Maker metadata Fetch action; the selected image is never sent to that service.

capabilities: Open a dedicated Pets Maker side-rail app only after explicit enablement and rail invocation.
Read one transparent local Maker PNG selected in the visible file control.
Collect exact Maker family, optional NFT number, trait IDs, lower-body, footwear, and palette choices.
Fetch public Maker traits for an explicitly selected family and NFT number and place them in the visible form for review.
Preview a deterministic 1024x1024 composite and download a validated two-file request ZIP.

notes: The only added host permission is maker.remilia.org for the explicit Fetch action; the package has no background, browser-tab, clipboard, or raw runtime-messaging access.
Composition requires explicit package-consent acknowledgement because local files and extension-origin package code are privileged inputs.

siteScopes: X/Twitter side-rail overlay opened explicitly by the user
Public Maker metadata requested only after an explicit Fetch

remoteServices.name: Remilia Maker metadata
remoteServices.purpose: Populate visible Pets Maker trait fields after an explicit Fetch.
remoteServices.dataSent: Selected public Maker family and NFT number only; no image, account, cookie, or authentication data.

notes: Stores only the disabled-by-default enablement toggle; form state and selected files are not persisted.

privacyNotes: The selected PNG and body choices stay in the open app and generated local ZIP; the image is never uploaded.
An explicit Fetch sends only the selected public Maker family and NFT number; returned traits populate the visible form and are not cached.
Installing the package does not enable it, pin it to the rail, read a file, or generate a bundle.

packages.name: Composer Kit
packages.summary: Composer actions, quick replies, Remibooru discovery, and reviewed maker handoffs in one package.

notes: Composer Kit is active in cumulative QA as a locally reviewed package, but its maintainer source is not yet checked into an allowlisted catalog artifact path.
It remains non-selectable until source, package hash, and trusted catalog review are committed together.

capabilities: Open the host-owned native Drafts action from the composer.
Manage local quick-reply phrases and explicitly select one for the host reply action.
Browse reviewed Remibooru reaction metadata, explicitly attach a sanitized thumbnail to the initiating composer, or open its canonical source page.
Open declared Milady, Remilio, Bonkler, and Kagami maker handoffs after explicit caption review.
Open CHEESEWORLD as an ordinary explicit external link.

notes: The package has no raw browser messaging, tab, clipboard, or X DOM access.
Remote services require explicit user actions and package-consent acknowledgement.

siteScopes: X/Twitter composer and reply action surfaces only

remoteServices.name: Remilia Maker
remoteServices.purpose: Open the explicitly selected maker with reviewed caption fields or random-meme mode.
remoteServices.dataSent: Only the user-reviewed Top text and Bottom text fields for the selected maker; no X account, cookie, authentication, or image data.

remoteServices.name: Remibooru
remoteServices.purpose: Query public reaction-media posts and facets and open canonical source or native upload pages.
remoteServices.dataSent: Explicit public query facets, pagination cursor, and page-size limit only; no X account, draft, cookie, authentication, image, tag, or upload data.

notes: Stores enablement and up to 20 local quick-reply phrases of at most 280 characters.

privacyNotes: The package cannot inspect X drafts, maker pages, Remibooru pages, tabs, clipboard contents, or authentication state.
Maker captions transfer only after an explicit package action; generated media remains user-reviewed and is never posted automatically.

Remibooru results are sanitized metadata and thumbnails. An explicit result click may ask the host to attach that recently returned thumbnail to the initiating composer; the package does not cache, expose original-media URLs, upload, or post media.
A selected quick reply is submitted by the reviewed host action only after the user explicitly clicks that reply row.

blockers.reason: The current Composer Kit 0.2.0-pilot source and exact package hash must be synchronized into this catalog checkout and receive trusted catalog review before selection can be enabled.

packages.name: Share Kit
packages.summary: Review and export a local PNG from an explicitly selected X/Twitter post share action.

notes: Reviewed first-party replacement preserving the stable tweetPng identity and existing visual/profile settings.

capabilities: Open Share Kit from an explicit contextual X/Twitter post share action.
Review selected post text, visible media, quote content, date, stats, colors, border, and watermark locally.
Export the reviewed result as a local PNG.

notes: Uses only the host permissions already present in the base extension.
Requires explicit package-consent and first-party-replacement acknowledgements.

siteScopes: The X/Twitter post explicitly selected through the host-owned share action

notes: Preserves Share Kit enablement and the existing Tweet PNG visual/profile settings.

privacyNotes: Selected post content is rendered locally after explicit user action.
No post content, media, account data, or generated PNG is sent to a remote service.
Export never posts, uploads, attaches, or mutates an account.
